title: CogME: A Cognition-Inspired Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Metric for Story Understanding
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a cognitive science-inspired metric for evaluating an AI's story understanding capabilities. The evaluation components (TARGET, CONTENT, THINKING) and their sub-components (e.g., Character, Causality, Recall, Reasoning) are purely cognitive and narrative-based. There is no mention or evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical dimensions in the proposed framework or the case study.
